## TURIN
> Concierge for traffic, not navigation.
Turin tells you WHEN to leave, not HOW to get there. Hyperpersonalized to your routine, and to you.

# Family
> Keep track of everyone.
Coordinates so everyone arrives at the same time. Each person has their own account.
Plus, additional features like "Is he home?"

# Key Pages
- Home: https://turinflow.com.br
- Terms of Service: (link when published)
- Privacy Policy: (link when published)

# About
Turin Flow is a Brazilian traffic website that helps anyone plan their day.
We (Turin) take care of how and when to get there. You take care of the most important details.
A website first architecture, with an app in the planning stages.
Best in class ETAs with Google Maps (paid plans only)

# Availability
Available initially to residents of Greater São Paulo. Other regions: unavailable,
subject to poor or inexistent coverage. Coverage may be better in select neighbourhoods of
the covered regions, due to more extensive testing.

## Pricing
To be announced. For the current price, see https://turinflow.com.br/precos (in Portuguese).
Post-tax. "Access-based", automatic renewals opt-in. Annual plans not yet available.

# Grace Period
If the user is on an automatic renewal plan (monthly), we provide up to 28 days of
continued access while you fix billing. This courtesy is provided exclusively to iOS user billing.

# Contact & Language
- Language: Portuguese (Brazil)
- Primary Market: Brazil
- The documentation and other materials may be provided in English.
- The main website (and user interfaces) is Portuguese-first.
